description: Implementation of NativeWindow11 using Windows.UI.Composition APIs for Direct3D 11 on Windows, including COM interop and window management functions.

classes.name: CompositorNativeWindow11
classes.description: A class managing a native window with Windows.UI.Composition APIs, supporting swap chain creation and window properties.

classes.name: RoHelper
classes.description: A helper class for Windows Runtime (WinRT) COM initialization, string handling, and API contract checks.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11
methods.description: Constructor initializing the window and alpha properties, setting up the host visual.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Stub method for initialization, always returns true.

methods.name: getClientRect
methods.description: Retrieves the window's client rectangle based on visual size and offset.

methods.name: isIconic
methods.description: Returns false, indicating window is not minimized.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a Direct3D swap chain linked to the composition surface.

methods.name: IsValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if the window is a supported sprite visual on supported Windows versions.

methods.name: IsSupportedWinRelease
methods.description: Checks if the Windows release supports WinRT APIs.

methods.name: IsSpriteVisual
methods.description: Determines if a window handle corresponds to a Windows.UI.Composition.ISpriteVisual.
